package.name: mecanumbot_custom_nav2
package.description: Autonomous exploration for Mecanumbot, and the robot's end of the 2D/3D comparison. The frontier explorer is the T1 pass -- RRT-based frontier detection over slam_toolbox's occupancy grid, driven through nav2's NavigateToPose action, ending on exit criteria that include the Deep3R server's verdict on the reconstruction. The agreement handler runs in both phases and turns that verdict into a nav2 keepout mask, a revisit list and markers, so the point cloud's knowledge of what the lidar plane cannot see reaches the navigation stack. The nav2 tuning itself is not here: it is a parameter file in mecanumbot_description, because it needed no code.
